+from qutebrowser.utils import qtutils

+def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes: Iterable[str]) -> Set[str]:
+    """Return missing filename suffixes for MIME types on affected Qt versions."""
+    if not (qtutils.version_check("6.2.3", compiled=False) and
+            not qtutils.version_check("6.7.0", compiled=False)):
+        return set()
+
+    upstream_mimetypes = list(upstream_mimetypes)
+    existing_suffixes = {item for item in upstream_mimetypes if item.startswith(".")}
+    extra_suffixes = set()
+
+    for mime in upstream_mimetypes:
+        if mime.startswith(".") or "/" not in mime:
+            continue
+        if mime.endswith("/*"):
+            prefix = mime[:-1]
+            extra_suffixes.update(
+                suffix for suffix, mapped_mime in mimetypes.types_map.items()
+                if mapped_mime.startswith(prefix)
+            )
+        else:
+            extra_suffixes.update(mimetypes.guess_all_extensions(mime))
+
+    return extra_suffixes - existing_suffixes
